title: 마지막 버스의 우산
style: Soft painterly digital illustration, muted rainy-night palette of deep blue and amber streetlight, gentle film grain, cinematic wide composition, original style

characters.name: 준
characters.look: a tired young man in his late twenties, short black hair, round glasses, navy raincoat, carrying a backpack

characters.name: 기사님
characters.look: a kind bus driver in his sixties, grey hair under a dark cap, light blue uniform shirt, deep smile lines

scenes.art: A nearly empty city bus stop at midnight in heavy rain. The young man stands alone under a broken streetlight, soaked, no umbrella, looking at his phone.

lines.t: 자정이 넘은 시각, 비는 그칠 생각이 없었다.

scenes.art: Interior of a dim late-night bus. The old driver turns slightly to hand a worn yellow umbrella over the fare box to the wet young man.

lines.t: 마지막 버스가 섰고, 기사님이 낡은 노란 우산을 내밀었다.

lines.say: 십 년째 아무도 안 찾아간 우산이에요.

scenes.art: Close view of the young man opening the worn yellow umbrella under a streetlight; inside the canopy a faded small paper tag is tied to a rib. Rain sparkles in amber light.

lines.t: 집 앞에서 우산을 펴자, 안쪽에 빛바랜 이름표가 매달려 있었다.

scenes.art: Next evening, clear sky after the rain. The young man waits at the same bus stop holding a small bag of warm canned coffee, the yellow umbrella folded under his arm, a gentle smile.

lines.t: 다음 날 저녁, 준은 따뜻한 캔커피를 들고 같은 정류장에 섰다.
